ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly bimodal distribution; approximately 85% of the visible surface is low-intensity black, while a localized distal region on the left lobe contains high-intensity white pixels, creating a high local contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large, irregular contiguous white mottled blob is mapped to the distal 20-25% of the left lobe; the remaining 75-80% of the fluke surface is mapped as a uniform low-intensity black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is an obtuse-angled V-shape with a shallow bounding-box depth relative to the horizontal width of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (serrations) are visible along the continuous linear boundary of the left lobe's trailing edge; the right lobe's trailing edge appears relatively smoother with fewer distinct peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A convex mathematical curve characterizes the sweep of both lobes, tapering towards the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of a localized cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups situated within the white mottled patch on the distal left lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant localized depigmentation and scarring on the distal tip of the left fluke lobe.
